turns.text: Hello. I want to return order SC-5216. The email is thymele.jderescu@example.com.

Thank you, Thymele. Order SC-5216 has shipped but has not been delivered yet, and our returns policy only allows returns within 14 days of delivery, so I can't file a return for it now. Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, the customer pays the return postage, and staff approve every refund. I have passed your message to a colleague who can look at the order with you further.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

input.summary: Verified customer requested a return for SC-5216. Order is shipped but not yet delivered, so the return policy does not allow it yet. I declined. Policy: catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery, customer pays return postage, staff approve refunds.
